To get your app live and shared with friends, follow these two main steps: **Deployment** (getting it on the web) and **Supabase Integration** (replacing `localStorage` with a real database).

### Phase 1: Deployment (GitHub & Vercel)

1.  **Create a GitHub Repository**:
    *   Go to [GitHub](https://github.com) and create a new repository (e.g., `neck-tracker`).
    *   Follow the instructions to push your code:
        ```bash
        git init
        git add .
        git commit -m "initial commit"
        git remote add origin YOUR_REPO_URL
        git push -u origin main
        ```
2.  **Deploy to Vercel**:
    *   Go to [Vercel](https://vercel.com) and sign in with GitHub.
    *   Click **"Add New"** -> **"Project"**.
    *   Import your `neck-tracker` repository.
    *   Vercel will automatically detect it's a React/Vite/Next app. Click **Deploy**.
    *   *Note: Your app is now live at a URL like `neck-tracker.vercel.app`!*

### Phase 2: Supabase Setup

1.  **Create Project**: Go to [Supabase](https://supabase.com), create a project, and get your **URL** and **Anon Key**.
2.  **Run SQL**: In the Supabase "SQL Editor", run this to create your tables:
    ```sql
    -- Create Exercises Table
    create table exercises (
      id bigint primary key,
      user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
      title text not null,
      description text,
      category text,
      video_url text,
      rating int default 0,
      created_at timestamp with time zone default timezone('utc'::text, now())
    );

    -- Create Routines Table
    create table routines (
      id bigint primary key,
      user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
      name text not null,
      exercise_items jsonb default '[]'::jsonb,
      sub_routines jsonb default '[]'::jsonb,
      schedule jsonb,
      is_expanded boolean default true
    );

    -- Create Categories Table
    create table categories (
      id uuid default gen_random_uuid() primary key,
      user_id uuid references auth.users not null,
      name text not null,
      color text not null
    );
    ```

### Phase 3: Code Changes
I will now update your code to use the Supabase client. You will need to add your Supabase URL and Key to your Vercel Environment Variables.
